close_reason: Acknowledged decision: Cow<'a, str> for zero-alloc happy path
description:
ServerName::Dns and MailboxName::local / domain_a_label use Cow<'a, str>. Pure-ASCII lower-case DNS targets, simple ASCII mailboxes, and pre-lowercased domain inputs stay borrowed. Only U-label conversion, ASCII case-folding, or whitespace trimming forces Owned.

A future contributor will look at this and ask 'why not just String?' — String is simpler and unconditionally allocates. The Cow path is justified by the prevalidation use case in AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6: a TLS server that accepts O(connection-count) hostname lookups against a fixed set of certs benefits from the borrowed happy path. Test 'dns_name_accepts_simple' asserts Cow::Borrowed on simple ASCII input, locking the contract.

Defend: do not 'simplify' to String without measuring.
title: Decision: Cow<'a, str> on ServerName / MailboxName to keep zero-alloc happy path
